data.title: npm audit signatures fails on blessed's expired key
data.description: blessed@0.1.81 carries an npm registry signature whose public key expired 2025-01-29, and 'npm audit signatures' aborts on the first bad signature — so anyone who tries to verify kadence the standard way gets an error about a dependency, on every install. Two ways out: replace blessed (neo-blessed and friends are also unmaintained, so measure first) or vendor the part of it the TUI uses, which would also drop 1.8 MB from the install. Until then, a README line saying what the error is and how to check our own attestation by hand.
